with scope as materialized (
      select p.id as project_id, c.id as claim_id
      from projects p
      left join claims c on c.project_id=p.id and c.id=$1::uuid
      where p.id=$2::uuid
    ),
    current_revision as (
      select r.id, r.sequence::text as sequence, r.state
      from scope s
      join lateral (
        select current_r.id, current_r.sequence, current_r.state
        from claim_revisions current_r
        where current_r.project_id=s.project_id and current_r.claim_id=s.claim_id
          and current_r.finalized_at is not null
        order by current_r.sequence desc
        limit 1
      ) r on true
    ),
    anchor_status as (select true as anchor_valid),
    page_candidates as materialized (
      select r.id, r.sequence::text as sequence, r.state, r.claim_text, r.researcher_note,
        r.created_at, r.finalized_at
      from scope s
      join claim_revisions r on r.project_id=s.project_id and r.claim_id=s.claim_id
      where r.finalized_at is not null and true and true
      order by r.sequence desc, r.id desc
      limit $3
    ),
    visible_page as materialized (
      select * from page_candidates order by sequence::bigint desc, id desc limit $4
    ),
    page_state as (select count(*) > $5 as has_more from page_candidates),
    evidence_support_counts as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as support_count
      from claim_revision_evidence_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      group by s.claim_revision_id
    ),
    extraction_support_counts as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as support_count
      from claim_revision_extraction_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      group by s.claim_revision_id
    ),
    synthesis_support_counts as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as support_count
      from claim_revision_synthesis_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      group by s.claim_revision_id
    ),
    structural_papers as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, e.paper_id
      from claim_revision_evidence_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join evidence e on e.project_id=s.project_id and e.id=s.evidence_id
      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_extraction_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=s.project_id and x.id=s.extraction_revision_id
      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_synthesis_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join synthesis_revision_supports ss on ss.project_id=s.project_id and ss.synthesis_revision_id=s.synthesis_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=ss.project_id and x.id=ss.extraction_revision_id
    ),
    citation_papers as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, e.paper_id
      from claim_revision_evidence_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join evidence e on e.project_id=s.project_id and e.id=s.evidence_id
      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_extraction_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=s.project_id and x.id=s.extraction_revision_id
      join extraction_revision_evidence path on path.project_id=x.project_id and path.revision_id=x.id and path.paper_id=x.paper_id
      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_synthesis_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join synthesis_revision_supports ss on ss.project_id=s.project_id and ss.synthesis_revision_id=s.synthesis_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=ss.project_id and x.id=ss.extraction_revision_id
      join extraction_revision_evidence path on path.project_id=x.project_id and path.revision_id=x.id and path.paper_id=x.paper_id
    ),
    structural_counts as (
      select claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as paper_count from structural_papers group by claim_revision_id
    ),
    citation_counts as (
      select claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as paper_count from citation_papers group by claim_revision_id
    ),
    metrics as (
      select v.*,
        coalesce(e.support_count, '0') as direct_evidence_count,
        coalesce(x.support_count, '0') as extraction_revision_count,
        coalesce(s.support_count, '0') as synthesis_revision_count,
        coalesce(e.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(x.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(s.support_count::bigint, 0) as total_support_count,
        coalesce(c.paper_count, '0') as citation_candidate_count,
        coalesce(p.paper_count, '0') as distinct_paper_count,
        case when v.state='active' and
          (coalesce(e.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(x.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(s.support_count::bigint, 0)) > 0
          then 'supported' else 'unsupported' end as support_status
      from visible_page v
      left join evidence_support_counts e on e.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join extraction_support_counts x on x.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join synthesis_support_counts s on s.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join citation_counts c on c.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join structural_counts p on p.claim_revision_id=v.id
    ),
    meta as (
      select s.project_id, s.claim_id, c.id as current_id, c.sequence as current_sequence, c.state as current_state
      from scope s left join current_revision c on true
    )
    select m.project_id is not null as project_exists, m.claim_id is not null as claim_exists,
      (select anchor_valid from anchor_status) as anchor_valid,
      m.current_id, m.current_sequence, m.current_state, ps.has_more,
      r.id as revision_id, r.sequence, r.state, left(r.claim_text, 448) as claim_text_preview,
      (r.claim_text is not null and char_length(r.claim_text) > 448) as claim_text_truncated,
      left(r.researcher_note, 256) as researcher_note_preview,
      (r.researcher_note is not null and char_length(r.researcher_note) > 256) as researcher_note_truncated,
      r.created_at, r.finalized_at, r.support_status, r.direct_evidence_count,
      r.extraction_revision_count, r.synthesis_revision_count, r.total_support_count,
      r.citation_candidate_count, r.distinct_paper_count
    from meta m
    cross join page_state ps
    left join metrics r on true
    order by r.sequence::bigint desc nulls last, r.id desc nulls last

with scope as materialized (

      select r.id, r.sequence::text as sequence, r.state
      from scope s

        select current_r.id, current_r.sequence, current_r.state
        from synthesis_revisions current_r
        where current_r.project_id=s.project_id and current_r.synthesis_statement_id=s.statement_id
          and current_r.finalized_at is not null
        order by current_r.sequence desc
        limit 1
      ) r on true
    ),
    anchor_status as (select true as anchor_valid),
    page_candidates as materialized (
      select r.id, r.sequence::text as sequence, r.state, r.title, r.statement_text,

      join synthesis_revisions r on r.project_id=s.project_id and r.synthesis_statement_id=s.statement_id

      order by r.sequence asc, r.id asc
      limit $3

      select * from page_candidates order by sequence::bigint asc, id asc limit $4
    ),

      select s.synthesis_revision_id,
        count(distinct s.extraction_revision_id)::text as supporting_revision_count,
        count(distinct x.paper_id)::text as supporting_paper_count,
        count(distinct x.field_id)::text as supporting_field_count
      from visible_page v
      join synthesis_revision_supports s on s.project_id=$6::uuid and s.synthesis_revision_id=v.id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=s.project_id and x.id=s.extraction_revision_id
      group by s.synthesis_revision_id
    ),
    metrics as (
      select v.*, coalesce(c.supporting_revision_count, '0') as supporting_revision_count,
        coalesce(c.supporting_paper_count, '0') as supporting_paper_count,
        coalesce(c.supporting_field_count, '0') as supporting_field_count,
        (coalesce(c.supporting_revision_count::bigint, 0) > 0) as is_supported
      from visible_page v left join support_counts c on c.synthesis_revision_id=v.id
    ),
    meta as (
      select s.project_id, s.statement_id, c.id as current_id, c.sequence as current_sequence, c.state as current_state

with scope as materialized (

      from scope s
      join claim_revisions r on r.project_id=s.project_id and r.claim_id=s.claim_id
      where r.finalized_at is not null and true and true
      order by r.sequence desc, r.id desc
      limit $3
    ),
    visible_page as materialized (
      select * from page_candidates order by sequence::bigint desc, id desc limit $4
    ),
    page_state as (select count(*) > $5 as has_more from page_candidates),
    evidence_support_counts as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as support_count
      from claim_revision_evidence_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      group by s.claim_revision_id
    ),
    extraction_support_counts as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as support_count
      from claim_revision_extraction_supports s

    ),
    synthesis_support_counts as (

      from claim_revision_synthesis_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      group by s.claim_revision_id
    ),
    structural_papers as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, e.paper_id
      from claim_revision_evidence_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join evidence e on e.project_id=s.project_id and e.id=s.evidence_id
      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_extraction_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=s.project_id and x.id=s.extraction_revision_id
      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_synthesis_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join synthesis_revision_supports ss on ss.project_id=s.project_id and ss.synthesis_revision_id=s.synthesis_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=ss.project_id and x.id=ss.extraction_revision_id
    ),
    citation_papers as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, e.paper_id
      from claim_revision_evidence_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join evidence e on e.project_id=s.project_id and e.id=s.evidence_id
      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_extraction_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=s.project_id and x.id=s.extraction_revision_id
      join extraction_revision_evidence path on path.project_id=x.project_id and path.revision_id=x.id and path.paper_id=x.paper_id
      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_synthesis_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join synthesis_revision_supports ss on ss.project_id=s.project_id and ss.synthesis_revision_id=s.synthesis_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=ss.project_id and x.id=ss.extraction_revision_id
      join extraction_revision_evidence path on path.project_id=x.project_id and path.revision_id=x.id and path.paper_id=x.paper_id
    ),
    structural_counts as (
      select claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as paper_count from structural_papers group by claim_revision_id
    ),
    citation_counts as (
      select claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as paper_count from citation_papers group by claim_revision_id
    ),
    metrics as (
      select v.*,
        coalesce(e.support_count, '0') as direct_evidence_count,
        coalesce(x.support_count, '0') as extraction_revision_count,
        coalesce(s.support_count, '0') as synthesis_revision_count,
        coalesce(e.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(x.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(s.support_count::bigint, 0) as total_support_count,
        coalesce(c.paper_count, '0') as citation_candidate_count,
        coalesce(p.paper_count, '0') as distinct_paper_count,
        case when v.state='active' and
          (coalesce(e.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(x.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(s.support_count::bigint, 0)) > 0
          then 'supported' else 'unsupported' end as support_status
      from visible_page v
      left join evidence_support_counts e on e.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join extraction_support_counts x on x.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join synthesis_support_counts s on s.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join citation_counts c on c.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join structural_counts p on p.claim_revision_id=v.id
    ),
    meta as (
      select s.project_id, s.claim_id, c.id as current_id, c.sequence as current_sequence, c.state as current_state
      from scope s left join current_revision c on true
    )
    select m.project_id is not null as project_exists, m.claim_id is not null as claim_exists,
      (select anchor_valid from anchor_status) as anchor_valid,
      m.current_id, m.current_sequence, m.current_state, ps.has_more,
      r.id as revision_id, r.sequence, r.state, left(r.claim_text, 448) as claim_text_preview,
      (r.claim_text is not null and char_length(r.claim_text) > 448) as claim_text_truncated,
      left(r.researcher_note, 256) as researcher_note_preview,
      (r.researcher_note is not null and char_length(r.researcher_note) > 256) as researcher_note_truncated,
      r.created_at, r.finalized_at, r.support_status, r.direct_evidence_count,
      r.extraction_revision_count, r.synthesis_revision_count, r.total_support_count,
      r.citation_candidate_count, r.distinct_paper_count
    from meta m
    cross join page_state ps
    left join metrics r on true
    order by r.sequence::bigint desc nulls last, r.id desc nulls last

      select project_id, paper_id,
        (array_agg(outcome order by sequence desc, id desc))[1] as current_retrieval_outcome,
        true as has_retrieval_history,
        bool_or(outcome='retrieved') as ever_retrieved
      from full_text_retrieval_attempts
      where project_id=$5::uuid and paper_id in ($6::uuid)
      group by project_id, paper_id
    ), analytical_history as (
      select distinct project_id, paper_id
      from extraction_value_revisions
      where project_id=$7::uuid and finalized_at is not null and paper_id in ($8::uuid)
    ), review_facts as (
      select p.project_id, p.id as paper_id, p.created_at,
        ta.decision as title_abstract_decision,
        ft.decision as full_text_decision,
        rf.current_retrieval_outcome as current_retrieval_outcome,
        coalesce(rf.current_retrieval_outcome, 'not_sought') as full_text_retrieval_state,
        coalesce(rf.has_retrieval_history, false) as has_retrieval_history,
        coalesce(rf.ever_retrieved, false) as ever_retrieved,
        (ah.paper_id is not null) as has_analytical_history
      from papers p
      left join latest_title_abstract ta on ta.project_id=p.project_id and ta.paper_id=p.id
      left join latest_full_text ft on ft.project_id=p.project_id and ft.paper_id=p.id
      left join retrieval_facts rf on rf.project_id=p.project_id and rf.paper_id=p.id
      left join analytical_history ah on ah.project_id=p.project_id and ah.paper_id=p.id
      where p.project_id=$9::uuid and p.id in ($10::uuid)
    )
  , target_rows as (
      select (e.value->>'paperId')::uuid as paper_id,
        (e.value->>'fieldId')::uuid as field_id,
        (e.value->>'extractionRevisionId')::uuid as extraction_revision_id,
        e.ordinality as target_order
      from jsonb_array_elements($11::jsonb) with ordinality as e(value, ordinality)
    )
    select t.paper_id, t.field_id, t.extraction_revision_id, t.target_order,
      rf.title_abstract_decision, rf.full_text_decision, rf.full_text_retrieval_state,
      rf.has_retrieval_history, rf.ever_retrieved, rf.has_analytical_history,
      exact.finalized_at as exact_finalized_at, exact.value_state as exact_value_state,
      f.archived_at as field_archived_at,
      current_revision.id as current_revision_id, current_revision.sequence as current_revision_sequence,
      current_revision.value_state as current_value_state,
      current_revision.text_value as current_text_value, current_revision.number_value as current_number_value,
      current_revision.boolean_value as current_boolean_value, current_revision.option_id as current_option_id,
      current_option.label as current_option_label
    from target_rows t
    join review_facts rf on rf.project_id=$12::uuid and rf.paper_id=t.paper_id
    join extraction_value_revisions exact on exact.project_id=$13::uuid
      and exact.id=t.extraction_revision_id and exact.paper_id=t.paper_id and exact.field_id=t.field_id
    join extraction_fields f on f.project_id=$14::uuid and f.id=t.field_id
    left join extraction_values v on v.project_id=$15::uuid and v.paper_id=t.paper_id and v.field_id=t.field_id
    left join lateral (
      select r.id, r.sequence, r.value_state, r.text_value, r.number_value, r.boolean_value, r.option_id
      from extraction_value_revisions r
      where r.project_id=$16::uuid and r.extraction_value_id=v.id and r.finalized_at is not null
      order by r.sequence desc, r.id desc
      limit 1
    ) current_revision on true
    left join extraction_options current_option on current_option.project_id=$17::uuid
      and current_option.field_id=t.field_id and current_option.id=current_revision.option_id
    order by t.target_order

with scope as materialized (

        from synthesis_revisions current_r
        where current_r.project_id=s.project_id and current_r.synthesis_statement_id=s.statement_id

    ),
    anchor_status as (select true as anchor_valid),

        (coalesce(c.supporting_revision_count::bigint, 0) > 0) as is_supported

      from scope s left join current_revision c on true
    )
    select m.project_id is not null as project_exists, m.statement_id is not null as statement_exists,
      (select anchor_valid from anchor_status) as anchor_valid,
      m.current_id, m.current_sequence, m.current_state, ps.has_more,
      r.id as revision_id, r.sequence, r.state, left(r.title, 96) as title_preview,
      (r.title is not null and char_length(r.title) > 96) as title_truncated,
      left(r.statement_text, 320) as statement_preview,
      (r.statement_text is not null and char_length(r.statement_text) > 320) as statement_truncated,
      left(r.researcher_note, 160) as researcher_note_preview,
      (r.researcher_note is not null and char_length(r.researcher_note) > 160) as researcher_note_truncated,
      r.created_at, r.finalized_at, r.is_supported,
      r.supporting_revision_count, r.supporting_paper_count, r.supporting_field_count
    from meta m

    left join metrics r on true
    order by r.sequence::bigint asc nulls last, r.id asc nulls last

      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=s.project_id and x.id=s.extraction_revision_id
      union

      join synthesis_revision_supports ss on ss.project_id=s.project_id and ss.synthesis_revision_id=s.synthesis_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=ss.project_id and x.id=ss.extraction_revision_id

      join evidence e on e.project_id=s.project_id and e.id=s.evidence_id
      union

      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id

with scope as materialized (
      select p.id as project_id, c.id as claim_id

        from claim_revisions current_r

          and current_r.finalized_at is not null
        order by current_r.sequence desc
        limit 1
      ) r on true
    ),
    anchor_status as (select true as anchor_valid),
    page_candidates as materialized (
      select r.id, r.sequence::text as sequence, r.state, r.claim_text, r.researcher_note,
        r.created_at, r.finalized_at
      from scope s
      join claim_revisions r on r.project_id=s.project_id and r.claim_id=s.claim_id
      where r.finalized_at is not null and true and true
      order by r.sequence desc, r.id desc
      limit $3
    ),
    visible_page as materialized (
      select * from page_candidates order by sequence::bigint desc, id desc limit $4
    ),
    page_state as (select count(*) > $5 as has_more from page_candidates),
    evidence_support_counts as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as support_count
      from claim_revision_evidence_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      group by s.claim_revision_id
    ),
    extraction_support_counts as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as support_count
      from claim_revision_extraction_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      group by s.claim_revision_id
    ),
    synthesis_support_counts as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as support_count
      from claim_revision_synthesis_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      group by s.claim_revision_id
    ),
    structural_papers as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, e.paper_id
      from claim_revision_evidence_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join evidence e on e.project_id=s.project_id and e.id=s.evidence_id
      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_extraction_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=s.project_id and x.id=s.extraction_revision_id
      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_synthesis_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join synthesis_revision_supports ss on ss.project_id=s.project_id and ss.synthesis_revision_id=s.synthesis_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=ss.project_id and x.id=ss.extraction_revision_id
    ),
    citation_papers as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, e.paper_id
      from claim_revision_evidence_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join evidence e on e.project_id=s.project_id and e.id=s.evidence_id
      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_extraction_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=s.project_id and x.id=s.extraction_revision_id
      join extraction_revision_evidence path on path.project_id=x.project_id and path.revision_id=x.id and path.paper_id=x.paper_id
      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_synthesis_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join synthesis_revision_supports ss on ss.project_id=s.project_id and ss.synthesis_revision_id=s.synthesis_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=ss.project_id and x.id=ss.extraction_revision_id
      join extraction_revision_evidence path on path.project_id=x.project_id and path.revision_id=x.id and path.paper_id=x.paper_id
    ),
    structural_counts as (
      select claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as paper_count from structural_papers group by claim_revision_id
    ),
    citation_counts as (
      select claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as paper_count from citation_papers group by claim_revision_id
    ),
    metrics as (
      select v.*,
        coalesce(e.support_count, '0') as direct_evidence_count,
        coalesce(x.support_count, '0') as extraction_revision_count,
        coalesce(s.support_count, '0') as synthesis_revision_count,
        coalesce(e.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(x.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(s.support_count::bigint, 0) as total_support_count,
        coalesce(c.paper_count, '0') as citation_candidate_count,
        coalesce(p.paper_count, '0') as distinct_paper_count,
        case when v.state='active' and
          (coalesce(e.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(x.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(s.support_count::bigint, 0)) > 0
          then 'supported' else 'unsupported' end as support_status
      from visible_page v
      left join evidence_support_counts e on e.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join extraction_support_counts x on x.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join synthesis_support_counts s on s.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join citation_counts c on c.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join structural_counts p on p.claim_revision_id=v.id

    meta as (
      select s.project_id, s.claim_id, c.id as current_id, c.sequence as current_sequence, c.state as current_state
      from scope s left join current_revision c on true
    )
    select m.project_id is not null as project_exists, m.claim_id is not null as claim_exists,

      m.current_id, m.current_sequence, m.current_state, ps.has_more,
      r.id as revision_id, r.sequence, r.state, left(r.claim_text, 448) as claim_text_preview,

      r.created_at, r.finalized_at, r.support_status, r.direct_evidence_count,
      r.extraction_revision_count, r.synthesis_revision_count, r.total_support_count,
      r.citation_candidate_count, r.distinct_paper_count
    from meta m
    cross join page_state ps
    left join metrics r on true
    order by r.sequence::bigint desc nulls last, r.id desc nulls last

with eligible as (

    from evidence e
    join papers p on p.project_id=e.project_id and p.id=e.paper_id
    left join lateral (
      select d.decision
      from evidence_review_decisions d
      where d.project_id=e.project_id and d.evidence_id=e.id
      order by d.sequence desc
      limit 1
    ) review on true
    where e.project_id=$1
      and coalesce(review.decision, 'unreviewed') <> 'rejected'
      and true
  )
            select eligible.id
            from eligible
            join jsonb_array_elements_text($2::jsonb) as requested(id)
              on requested.id::uuid = eligible.id

with eligible as (
    select r.id, r.project_id, r.paper_id, r.field_id, r.sequence, r.field_type,
      r.value_state, r.text_value, r.number_value, r.boolean_value, r.option_id,
      r.researcher_note, r.created_at, p.title as paper_title,
      f.name as field_name, o.label as option_label,
      not exists (
        select 1 from extraction_value_revisions newer
        where newer.project_id=r.project_id and newer.extraction_value_id=r.extraction_value_id
          and newer.finalized_at is not null and newer.sequence > r.sequence
      ) as is_current_extraction_revision,
      coalesce(title_abstract.decision, 'unscreened') as screening_state
    from extraction_value_revisions r
    join papers p on p.project_id=r.project_id and p.id=r.paper_id
    join extraction_fields f on f.project_id=r.project_id and f.id=r.field_id
    left join extraction_options o on o.project_id=r.project_id and o.field_id=r.field_id and o.id=r.option_id
    left join lateral (
      select d.decision
      from screening_decisions d
      where d.project_id=r.project_id and d.paper_id=r.paper_id and d.stage='title_abstract'
      order by d.sequence desc
      limit 1
    ) title_abstract on true
    left join lateral (
      select d.decision
      from full_text_screening_decisions d
      where d.project_id=r.project_id and d.paper_id=r.paper_id
      order by d.sequence desc
      limit 1
    ) full_text on true
    where r.project_id=$1
      and r.finalized_at is not null
      and r.value_state <> 'cleared'
      and title_abstract.decision='include'
      and full_text.decision='include'
      and true
  )
            select eligible.id
            from eligible
            join jsonb_array_elements_text($2::jsonb) as requested(id)
              on requested.id::uuid = eligible.id

        and latest.synthesis_statement_id=r.synthesis_statement_id

      order by latest.sequence desc

    ) current_revision on true

      and r.state='active'

  )

              on requested.id::uuid = eligible.id

      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=s.project_id and x.id=s.extraction_revision_id
      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_synthesis_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join synthesis_revision_supports ss on ss.project_id=s.project_id and ss.synthesis_revision_id=s.synthesis_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=ss.project_id and x.id=ss.extraction_revision_id
    ),
    citation_papers as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, e.paper_id
      from claim_revision_evidence_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join evidence e on e.project_id=s.project_id and e.id=s.evidence_id
      union

      from claim_revision_extraction_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=s.project_id and x.id=s.extraction_revision_id
      join extraction_revision_evidence path on path.project_id=x.project_id and path.revision_id=x.id and path.paper_id=x.paper_id
      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_synthesis_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join synthesis_revision_supports ss on ss.project_id=s.project_id and ss.synthesis_revision_id=s.synthesis_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=ss.project_id and x.id=ss.extraction_revision_id
      join extraction_revision_evidence path on path.project_id=x.project_id and path.revision_id=x.id and path.paper_id=x.paper_id
    ),
    structural_counts as (
      select claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as paper_count from structural_papers group by claim_revision_id
    ),
    citation_counts as (
      select claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as paper_count from citation_papers group by claim_revision_id
    ),
    metrics as (
      select v.*,
        coalesce(e.support_count, '0') as direct_evidence_count,
        coalesce(x.support_count, '0') as extraction_revision_count,
        coalesce(s.support_count, '0') as synthesis_revision_count,
        coalesce(e.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(x.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(s.support_count::bigint, 0) as total_support_count,
        coalesce(c.paper_count, '0') as citation_candidate_count,
        coalesce(p.paper_count, '0') as distinct_paper_count,
        case when v.state='active' and
          (coalesce(e.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(x.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(s.support_count::bigint, 0)) > 0
          then 'supported' else 'unsupported' end as support_status

      left join extraction_support_counts x on x.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join synthesis_support_counts s on s.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join citation_counts c on c.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join structural_counts p on p.claim_revision_id=v.id
    ),
    meta as (
      select s.project_id, s.claim_id, c.id as current_id, c.sequence as current_sequence, c.state as current_state
      from scope s left join current_revision c on true
    )
    select m.project_id is not null as project_exists, m.claim_id is not null as claim_exists,

      m.current_id, m.current_sequence, m.current_state, ps.has_more,
      r.id as revision_id, r.sequence, r.state, left(r.claim_text, 448) as claim_text_preview,

      r.created_at, r.finalized_at, r.support_status, r.direct_evidence_count,
      r.extraction_revision_count, r.synthesis_revision_count, r.total_support_count,
      r.citation_candidate_count, r.distinct_paper_count
    from meta m
    cross join page_state ps
    left join metrics r on true
    order by r.sequence::bigint desc nulls last, r.id desc nulls last

      from scope s

    ),
    visible_page as materialized (
      select * from page_candidates order by sequence::bigint asc, id asc limit $4
    ),
    page_state as (select count(*) > $5 as has_more from page_candidates),
    support_counts as (
      select s.synthesis_revision_id,
        count(distinct s.extraction_revision_id)::text as supporting_revision_count,

        coalesce(c.supporting_field_count, '0') as supporting_field_count,

select s.project_id, s.synthesis_revision_id, s.extraction_revision_id, s.created_at as support_created_at,
        r.id as revision_id, r.sequence as revision_sequence, r.paper_id, r.field_id, r.extraction_value_id,
        r.field_type, r.value_state, r.text_value, r.number_value, r.boolean_value, r.option_id,
        r.researcher_note as revision_note, r.created_at as revision_created_at, r.finalized_at as revision_finalized_at,
        p.id as paper_id_value, p.title as paper_title, p.authors, p.publication_year, p.venue, p.doi,
        p.abstract, p.bibliographic_note, p.created_at as paper_created_at, p.updated_at as paper_updated_at,
        f.id as field_id_value, f.name as field_name, f.description as field_description,
        f.field_type as field_type_value, f.required, f.sort_order, f.created_at as field_created_at,
        f.updated_at as field_updated_at, f.archived_at as field_archived_at,
        exists(select 1 from extraction_value_revisions cr
          where cr.project_id=r.project_id and cr.extraction_value_id=r.extraction_value_id
            and cr.finalized_at is not null and cr.sequence > r.sequence) as has_newer_revision
      from synthesis_revision_supports s
      join synthesis_revisions sr on sr.project_id=s.project_id and sr.id=s.synthesis_revision_id and sr.finalized_at is not null
      join extraction_value_revisions r on r.project_id=s.project_id and r.id=s.extraction_revision_id and r.finalized_at is not null
      join papers p on p.project_id=r.project_id and p.id=r.paper_id
      join extraction_fields f on f.project_id=r.project_id and f.id=r.field_id
      where s.project_id=$1 and s.synthesis_revision_id in ($2::uuid)
      order by s.synthesis_revision_id, s.created_at, s.extraction_revision_id

select i.id, i.sequence::text as sequence, i.project_id, i.synthesis_statement_id,
          i.synthesis_revision_id, i.convergence_state, i.summary, i.researcher_note,
          i.created_at, i.finalized_at
        from synthesis_interpretations i
        join synthesis_revisions r on r.project_id=i.project_id
          and r.synthesis_statement_id=i.synthesis_statement_id and r.id=i.synthesis_revision_id
          and r.finalized_at is not null
        where i.project_id=$1::uuid and i.synthesis_statement_id=$2::uuid
          and i.synthesis_revision_id=$3::uuid and i.finalized_at is not null
          and i.id=$4::uuid

set transaction isolation level repeatable read read only

with scope as materialized (
      select p.id as project_id, s.id as statement_id, r.id as revision_id
      from projects p
      left join synthesis_statements s on s.project_id=p.id and s.id=$1::uuid
      left join synthesis_revisions r on r.project_id=s.project_id and r.synthesis_statement_id=s.id
        and r.id=$2::uuid and r.finalized_at is not null
      where p.id=$3::uuid
    ),
    current_interpretation as (
        select i.id, i.sequence::text as sequence, i.convergence_state, i.finalized_at
        from scope s
        join lateral (
          select current_i.id, current_i.sequence, current_i.convergence_state, current_i.finalized_at
          from synthesis_interpretations current_i
          where current_i.project_id=s.project_id and current_i.synthesis_statement_id=s.statement_id
            and current_i.synthesis_revision_id=s.revision_id and current_i.finalized_at is not null
          order by current_i.sequence desc
          limit 1
        ) i on true
      ),
    anchor_status as (select true as anchor_valid),
    page_candidates as materialized (
      select i.id, i.sequence::text as sequence, i.convergence_state, i.summary,
        i.researcher_note, i.created_at, i.finalized_at
      from scope s
      join synthesis_interpretations i on i.project_id=s.project_id
        and i.synthesis_statement_id=s.statement_id and i.synthesis_revision_id=s.revision_id
      where i.finalized_at is not null and true and true
      order by i.sequence desc, i.id desc
      limit $4
    ),
    visible_page as materialized (
      select * from page_candidates order by sequence::bigint desc, id desc limit $5
    ),
    page_state as (select count(*) > $6 as has_more from page_candidates),
    limitation_counts as (
      select l.interpretation_id, count(*)::text as child_count
      from synthesis_interpretation_limitations l join visible_page v on v.id=l.interpretation_id
      where l.project_id=$7::uuid group by l.interpretation_id
    ),
    question_counts as (
      select q.interpretation_id, count(*)::text as child_count
      from synthesis_interpretation_questions q join visible_page v on v.id=q.interpretation_id
      where q.project_id=$8::uuid group by q.interpretation_id
    ),
    contradiction_counts as (
      select c.interpretation_id, count(*)::text as child_count
      from synthesis_interpretation_contradictions c join visible_page v on v.id=c.interpretation_id
      where c.project_id=$9::uuid group by c.interpretation_id
    ),
    metrics as (
      select v.*, coalesce(l.child_count, '0') as limitation_count,
        coalesce(q.child_count, '0') as question_count,
        coalesce(c.child_count, '0') as contradiction_count
      from visible_page v
      left join limitation_counts l on l.interpretation_id=v.id
      left join question_counts q on q.interpretation_id=v.id
      left join contradiction_counts c on c.interpretation_id=v.id
    ),
    meta as (
      select s.project_id, s.statement_id, s.revision_id,
        c.id as current_id, c.sequence as current_sequence,
        c.convergence_state as current_convergence_state, c.finalized_at as current_finalized_at
      from scope s left join current_interpretation c on true
    )
    select m.project_id is not null as project_exists, m.statement_id is not null as statement_exists,
      m.revision_id is not null as revision_exists,
      (select anchor_valid from anchor_status) as anchor_valid,
      m.current_id, m.current_sequence, m.current_convergence_state,
      m.current_finalized_at,
      ps.has_more, r.id as interpretation_id, r.sequence, r.convergence_state,
      left(r.summary, 448) as summary_preview, (char_length(r.summary) > 448) as summary_truncated,
      left(r.researcher_note, 256) as researcher_note_preview,
      (r.researcher_note is not null and char_length(r.researcher_note) > 256) as researcher_note_truncated,
      r.created_at, r.finalized_at, r.limitation_count, r.question_count, r.contradiction_count
    from meta m
    cross join page_state ps
    left join metrics r on true
    order by r.sequence::bigint desc nulls last, r.id desc nulls last

select i.id, i.sequence::text as sequence, i.project_id, i.synthesis_statement_id,
          i.synthesis_revision_id, i.convergence_state, i.summary, i.researcher_note,
          i.created_at, i.finalized_at, latest.id as current_interpretation_id
        from projects p
        join synthesis_statements s on s.project_id=p.id and s.id=$1::uuid
        join synthesis_revisions r on r.project_id=s.project_id and r.synthesis_statement_id=s.id
          and r.id=$2::uuid and r.finalized_at is not null
        join synthesis_interpretations i on i.project_id=r.project_id
          and i.synthesis_statement_id=r.synthesis_statement_id and i.synthesis_revision_id=r.id
          and i.id=$3::uuid and i.finalized_at is not null
        left join lateral (
          select current_i.id
          from synthesis_interpretations current_i
          where current_i.project_id=r.project_id
            and current_i.synthesis_statement_id=r.synthesis_statement_id
            and current_i.synthesis_revision_id=r.id

plans.label: claim-deep-1000-select-1
plans.sql:
with scope as materialized (
      select p.id as project_id, c.id as claim_id
      from projects p
      left join claims c on c.project_id=p.id and c.id=$1::uuid
      where p.id=$2::uuid
    ),
    current_revision as (
      select r.id, r.sequence::text as sequence, r.state
      from scope s
      join lateral (
        select current_r.id, current_r.sequence, current_r.state
        from claim_revisions current_r
        where current_r.project_id=s.project_id and current_r.claim_id=s.claim_id
          and current_r.finalized_at is not null
        order by current_r.sequence desc
        limit 1
      ) r on true
    ),
    anchor_status as (select exists (
        select 1 from claim_revisions anchor
        join scope s on s.project_id=anchor.project_id and s.claim_id=anchor.claim_id
        where anchor.id=$3::uuid
          and anchor.sequence=$4::bigint
          and anchor.finalized_at is not null
      ) as anchor_valid),
    page_candidates as materialized (
      select r.id, r.sequence::text as sequence, r.state, r.claim_text, r.researcher_note,
        r.created_at, r.finalized_at
      from scope s
      join claim_revisions r on r.project_id=s.project_id and r.claim_id=s.claim_id
      where r.finalized_at is not null and (r.sequence, r.id) < ($5::bigint, $6::uuid) and (select anchor_valid from anchor_status)
      order by r.sequence desc, r.id desc
      limit $7
    ),
    visible_page as materialized (
      select * from page_candidates order by sequence::bigint desc, id desc limit $8
    ),
    page_state as (select count(*) > $9 as has_more from page_candidates),
    evidence_support_counts as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as support_count
      from claim_revision_evidence_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      group by s.claim_revision_id
    ),
    extraction_support_counts as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as support_count
      from claim_revision_extraction_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      group by s.claim_revision_id
    ),
    synthesis_support_counts as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as support_count
      from claim_revision_synthesis_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      group by s.claim_revision_id
    ),
    structural_papers as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, e.paper_id
      from claim_revision_evidence_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join evidence e on e.project_id=s.project_id and e.id=s.evidence_id
      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_extraction_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=s.project_id and x.id=s.extraction_revision_id
      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_synthesis_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join synthesis_revision_supports ss on ss.project_id=s.project_id and ss.synthesis_revision_id=s.synthesis_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=ss.project_id and x.id=ss.extraction_revision_id
    ),
    citation_papers as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, e.paper_id
      from claim_revision_evidence_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join evidence e on e.project_id=s.project_id and e.id=s.evidence_id
      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_extraction_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=s.project_id and x.id=s.extraction_revision_id
      join extraction_revision_evidence path on path.project_id=x.project_id and path.revision_id=x.id and path.paper_id=x.paper_id
      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_synthesis_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join synthesis_revision_supports ss on ss.project_id=s.project_id and ss.synthesis_revision_id=s.synthesis_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=ss.project_id and x.id=ss.extraction_revision_id
      join extraction_revision_evidence path on path.project_id=x.project_id and path.revision_id=x.id and path.paper_id=x.paper_id
    ),
    structural_counts as (
      select claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as paper_count from structural_papers group by claim_revision_id
    ),
    citation_counts as (
      select claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as paper_count from citation_papers group by claim_revision_id
    ),
    metrics as (
      select v.*,
        coalesce(e.support_count, '0') as direct_evidence_count,
        coalesce(x.support_count, '0') as extraction_revision_count,
        coalesce(s.support_count, '0') as synthesis_revision_count,
        coalesce(e.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(x.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(s.support_count::bigint, 0) as total_support_count,
        coalesce(c.paper_count, '0') as citation_candidate_count,
        coalesce(p.paper_count, '0') as distinct_paper_count,
        case when v.state='active' and
          (coalesce(e.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(x.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(s.support_count::bigint, 0)) > 0
          then 'supported' else 'unsupported' end as support_status
      from visible_page v
      left join evidence_support_counts e on e.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join extraction_support_counts x on x.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join synthesis_support_counts s on s.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join citation_counts c on c.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join structural_counts p on p.claim_revision_id=v.id
    ),
    meta as (
      select s.project_id, s.claim_id, c.id as current_id, c.sequence as current_sequence, c.state as current_state
      from scope s left join current_revision c on true
    )
    select m.project_id is not null as project_exists, m.claim_id is not null as claim_exists,
      (select anchor_valid from anchor_status) as anchor_valid,
      m.current_id, m.current_sequence, m.current_state, ps.has_more,
      r.id as revision_id, r.sequence, r.state, left(r.claim_text, 448) as claim_text_preview,
      (r.claim_text is not null and char_length(r.claim_text) > 448) as claim_text_truncated,
      left(r.researcher_note, 256) as researcher_note_preview,
      (r.researcher_note is not null and char_length(r.researcher_note) > 256) as researcher_note_truncated,
      r.created_at, r.finalized_at, r.support_status, r.direct_evidence_count,
      r.extraction_revision_count, r.synthesis_revision_count, r.total_support_count,
      r.citation_candidate_count, r.distinct_paper_count
    from meta m
    cross join page_state ps
    left join metrics r on true
    order by r.sequence::bigint desc nulls last, r.id desc nulls last

with scope as materialized (
      select p.id as project_id, s.id as statement_id

      left join synthesis_statements s on s.project_id=p.id and s.id=$1::uuid
      where p.id=$2::uuid
    ),
    current_revision as (

      from scope s
      join lateral (
        select current_r.id, current_r.sequence, current_r.state
        from synthesis_revisions current_r
        where current_r.project_id=s.project_id and current_r.synthesis_statement_id=s.statement_id
          and current_r.finalized_at is not null
        order by current_r.sequence desc
        limit 1
      ) r on true
    ),
    anchor_status as (select exists (
        select 1 from synthesis_revisions anchor
        join scope s on s.project_id=anchor.project_id and s.statement_id=anchor.synthesis_statement_id
        where anchor.id=$3::uuid
          and anchor.sequence=$4::bigint
          and anchor.finalized_at is not null
      ) as anchor_valid),
    page_candidates as materialized (
      select r.id, r.sequence::text as sequence, r.state, r.title, r.statement_text,
        r.researcher_note, r.created_at, r.finalized_at
      from scope s
      join synthesis_revisions r on r.project_id=s.project_id and r.synthesis_statement_id=s.statement_id
      where r.finalized_at is not null and (r.sequence, r.id) > ($5::bigint, $6::uuid) and (select anchor_valid from anchor_status)
      order by r.sequence asc, r.id asc
      limit $7
    ),
    visible_page as materialized (
      select * from page_candidates order by sequence::bigint asc, id asc limit $8
    ),
    page_state as (select count(*) > $9 as has_more from page_candidates),
    support_counts as (
      select s.synthesis_revision_id,
        count(distinct s.extraction_revision_id)::text as supporting_revision_count,
        count(distinct x.paper_id)::text as supporting_paper_count,
        count(distinct x.field_id)::text as supporting_field_count
      from visible_page v
      join synthesis_revision_supports s on s.project_id=$10::uuid and s.synthesis_revision_id=v.id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=s.project_id and x.id=s.extraction_revision_id
      group by s.synthesis_revision_id
    ),
    metrics as (
      select v.*, coalesce(c.supporting_revision_count, '0') as supporting_revision_count,
        coalesce(c.supporting_paper_count, '0') as supporting_paper_count,
        coalesce(c.supporting_field_count, '0') as supporting_field_count,
        (coalesce(c.supporting_revision_count::bigint, 0) > 0) as is_supported
      from visible_page v left join support_counts c on c.synthesis_revision_id=v.id
    ),
    meta as (
      select s.project_id, s.statement_id, c.id as current_id, c.sequence as current_sequence, c.state as current_state
      from scope s left join current_revision c on true
    )
    select m.project_id is not null as project_exists, m.statement_id is not null as statement_exists,
      (select anchor_valid from anchor_status) as anchor_valid,
      m.current_id, m.current_sequence, m.current_state, ps.has_more,
      r.id as revision_id, r.sequence, r.state, left(r.title, 96) as title_preview,
      (r.title is not null and char_length(r.title) > 96) as title_truncated,
      left(r.statement_text, 320) as statement_preview,
      (r.statement_text is not null and char_length(r.statement_text) > 320) as statement_truncated,
      left(r.researcher_note, 160) as researcher_note_preview,
      (r.researcher_note is not null and char_length(r.researcher_note) > 160) as researcher_note_truncated,
      r.created_at, r.finalized_at, r.is_supported,
      r.supporting_revision_count, r.supporting_paper_count, r.supporting_field_count
    from meta m
    cross join page_state ps
    left join metrics r on true
    order by r.sequence::bigint asc nulls last, r.id asc nulls last

plans.sql:
with scope as materialized (
      select p.id as project_id, s.id as statement_id, r.id as revision_id
      from projects p
      left join synthesis_statements s on s.project_id=p.id and s.id=$1::uuid
      left join synthesis_revisions r on r.project_id=s.project_id and r.synthesis_statement_id=s.id
        and r.id=$2::uuid and r.finalized_at is not null
      where p.id=$3::uuid
    ),
    current_interpretation as (
        select i.id, i.sequence::text as sequence, i.convergence_state, i.finalized_at
        from scope s
        join lateral (
          select current_i.id, current_i.sequence, current_i.convergence_state, current_i.finalized_at
          from synthesis_interpretations current_i
          where current_i.project_id=s.project_id and current_i.synthesis_statement_id=s.statement_id
            and current_i.synthesis_revision_id=s.revision_id and current_i.finalized_at is not null
          order by current_i.sequence desc
          limit 1
        ) i on true
      ),
    anchor_status as (select exists (
        select 1 from synthesis_interpretations anchor
        join scope s on s.project_id=anchor.project_id and s.statement_id=anchor.synthesis_statement_id and s.revision_id=anchor.synthesis_revision_id
        where anchor.id=$4::uuid
          and anchor.sequence=$5::bigint
          and anchor.finalized_at is not null
      ) as anchor_valid),
    page_candidates as materialized (
      select i.id, i.sequence::text as sequence, i.convergence_state, i.summary,
        i.researcher_note, i.created_at, i.finalized_at
      from scope s
      join synthesis_interpretations i on i.project_id=s.project_id
        and i.synthesis_statement_id=s.statement_id and i.synthesis_revision_id=s.revision_id
      where i.finalized_at is not null and (i.sequence, i.id) < ($6::bigint, $7::uuid) and (select anchor_valid from anchor_status)
      order by i.sequence desc, i.id desc
      limit $8
    ),
    visible_page as materialized (
      select * from page_candidates order by sequence::bigint desc, id desc limit $9
    ),
    page_state as (select count(*) > $10 as has_more from page_candidates),
    limitation_counts as (
      select l.interpretation_id, count(*)::text as child_count
      from synthesis_interpretation_limitations l join visible_page v on v.id=l.interpretation_id
      where l.project_id=$11::uuid group by l.interpretation_id
    ),
    question_counts as (
      select q.interpretation_id, count(*)::text as child_count
      from synthesis_interpretation_questions q join visible_page v on v.id=q.interpretation_id
      where q.project_id=$12::uuid group by q.interpretation_id
    ),
    contradiction_counts as (
      select c.interpretation_id, count(*)::text as child_count
      from synthesis_interpretation_contradictions c join visible_page v on v.id=c.interpretation_id
      where c.project_id=$13::uuid group by c.interpretation_id
    ),
    metrics as (
      select v.*, coalesce(l.child_count, '0') as limitation_count,
        coalesce(q.child_count, '0') as question_count,
        coalesce(c.child_count, '0') as contradiction_count
      from visible_page v
      left join limitation_counts l on l.interpretation_id=v.id
      left join question_counts q on q.interpretation_id=v.id
      left join contradiction_counts c on c.interpretation_id=v.id
    ),
    meta as (
      select s.project_id, s.statement_id, s.revision_id,
        c.id as current_id, c.sequence as current_sequence,
        c.convergence_state as current_convergence_state, c.finalized_at as current_finalized_at
      from scope s left join current_interpretation c on true
    )
    select m.project_id is not null as project_exists, m.statement_id is not null as statement_exists,
      m.revision_id is not null as revision_exists,
      (select anchor_valid from anchor_status) as anchor_valid,
      m.current_id, m.current_sequence, m.current_convergence_state,
      m.current_finalized_at,
      ps.has_more, r.id as interpretation_id, r.sequence, r.convergence_state,
      left(r.summary, 448) as summary_preview, (char_length(r.summary) > 448) as summary_truncated,
      left(r.researcher_note, 256) as researcher_note_preview,
      (r.researcher_note is not null and char_length(r.researcher_note) > 256) as researcher_note_truncated,
      r.created_at, r.finalized_at, r.limitation_count, r.question_count, r.contradiction_count
    from meta m
    cross join page_state ps
    left join metrics r on true
    order by r.sequence::bigint desc nulls last, r.id desc nulls last

plans.sql:
with scope as materialized (
          select p.id as project_id, c.id as claim_id, c.created_at as claim_created_at,
            r.id as revision_id, r.sequence::text as revision_sequence
          from projects p
          join claims c on c.project_id=p.id and c.id=$1::uuid
          join claim_revisions r on r.project_id=c.project_id and r.claim_id=c.id
            and r.id=$2::uuid and r.finalized_at is not null
          where p.id=$3::uuid
        ),
        sequence_values as (
          select 'extraction_revision'::text as kind, x.id, x.sequence::text as sequence
          from scope s
          join claim_revision_extraction_supports support
            on support.project_id=s.project_id and support.claim_revision_id=s.revision_id
          join extraction_value_revisions x
            on x.project_id=s.project_id and x.id=support.extraction_revision_id
          union all
          select 'synthesis_revision'::text as kind, sr.id, sr.sequence::text as sequence
          from scope s
          join claim_revision_synthesis_supports support
            on support.project_id=s.project_id and support.claim_revision_id=s.revision_id
          join synthesis_revisions sr
            on sr.project_id=s.project_id and sr.id=support.synthesis_revision_id
          union all
          select 'extraction_revision'::text as kind, x.id, x.sequence::text as sequence
          from scope s
          join claim_revision_synthesis_supports claim_support
            on claim_support.project_id=s.project_id and claim_support.claim_revision_id=s.revision_id
          join synthesis_revision_supports support
            on support.project_id=s.project_id and support.synthesis_revision_id=claim_support.synthesis_revision_id
          join extraction_value_revisions x
            on x.project_id=s.project_id and x.id=support.extraction_revision_id
        )
        select s.project_id, s.claim_id, s.claim_created_at, s.revision_id,
          s.revision_sequence,
          $4::uuid as current_revision_id,
          coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(kind || ':' || id::text, sequence) from sequence_values), '{}'::jsonb) as sequence_map
        from scope s
        limit 1

          join synthesis_revisions sr
            on sr.project_id=s.project_id and sr.id=support.synthesis_revision_id

          select 'extraction_revision'::text as kind, x.id, x.sequence::text as sequence

          join synthesis_revision_supports support

plans.label: claim-deep-10000-select-1
plans.sql:
with scope as materialized (
      select p.id as project_id, c.id as claim_id
      from projects p
      left join claims c on c.project_id=p.id and c.id=$1::uuid
      where p.id=$2::uuid
    ),
    current_revision as (
      select r.id, r.sequence::text as sequence, r.state
      from scope s
      join lateral (
        select current_r.id, current_r.sequence, current_r.state
        from claim_revisions current_r
        where current_r.project_id=s.project_id and current_r.claim_id=s.claim_id
          and current_r.finalized_at is not null
        order by current_r.sequence desc
        limit 1
      ) r on true
    ),
    anchor_status as (select exists (
        select 1 from claim_revisions anchor
        join scope s on s.project_id=anchor.project_id and s.claim_id=anchor.claim_id
        where anchor.id=$3::uuid
          and anchor.sequence=$4::bigint
          and anchor.finalized_at is not null
      ) as anchor_valid),
    page_candidates as materialized (
      select r.id, r.sequence::text as sequence, r.state, r.claim_text, r.researcher_note,
        r.created_at, r.finalized_at
      from scope s
      join claim_revisions r on r.project_id=s.project_id and r.claim_id=s.claim_id
      where r.finalized_at is not null and (r.sequence, r.id) < ($5::bigint, $6::uuid) and (select anchor_valid from anchor_status)
      order by r.sequence desc, r.id desc
      limit $7
    ),
    visible_page as materialized (
      select * from page_candidates order by sequence::bigint desc, id desc limit $8
    ),
    page_state as (select count(*) > $9 as has_more from page_candidates),
    evidence_support_counts as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as support_count
      from claim_revision_evidence_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      group by s.claim_revision_id
    ),
    extraction_support_counts as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as support_count
      from claim_revision_extraction_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      group by s.claim_revision_id
    ),
    synthesis_support_counts as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as support_count
      from claim_revision_synthesis_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      group by s.claim_revision_id
    ),
    structural_papers as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, e.paper_id
      from claim_revision_evidence_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join evidence e on e.project_id=s.project_id and e.id=s.evidence_id
      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_extraction_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=s.project_id and x.id=s.extraction_revision_id
      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_synthesis_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join synthesis_revision_supports ss on ss.project_id=s.project_id and ss.synthesis_revision_id=s.synthesis_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=ss.project_id and x.id=ss.extraction_revision_id
    ),
    citation_papers as (
      select s.claim_revision_id, e.paper_id
      from claim_revision_evidence_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join evidence e on e.project_id=s.project_id and e.id=s.evidence_id
      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_extraction_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=s.project_id and x.id=s.extraction_revision_id
      join extraction_revision_evidence path on path.project_id=x.project_id and path.revision_id=x.id and path.paper_id=x.paper_id
      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_synthesis_supports s
      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id
      join synthesis_revision_supports ss on ss.project_id=s.project_id and ss.synthesis_revision_id=s.synthesis_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=ss.project_id and x.id=ss.extraction_revision_id
      join extraction_revision_evidence path on path.project_id=x.project_id and path.revision_id=x.id and path.paper_id=x.paper_id
    ),
    structural_counts as (
      select claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as paper_count from structural_papers group by claim_revision_id
    ),
    citation_counts as (
      select claim_revision_id, count(*)::text as paper_count from citation_papers group by claim_revision_id
    ),
    metrics as (
      select v.*,
        coalesce(e.support_count, '0') as direct_evidence_count,
        coalesce(x.support_count, '0') as extraction_revision_count,
        coalesce(s.support_count, '0') as synthesis_revision_count,
        coalesce(e.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(x.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(s.support_count::bigint, 0) as total_support_count,
        coalesce(c.paper_count, '0') as citation_candidate_count,
        coalesce(p.paper_count, '0') as distinct_paper_count,
        case when v.state='active' and
          (coalesce(e.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(x.support_count::bigint, 0) + coalesce(s.support_count::bigint, 0)) > 0
          then 'supported' else 'unsupported' end as support_status
      from visible_page v
      left join evidence_support_counts e on e.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join extraction_support_counts x on x.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join synthesis_support_counts s on s.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join citation_counts c on c.claim_revision_id=v.id
      left join structural_counts p on p.claim_revision_id=v.id
    ),
    meta as (
      select s.project_id, s.claim_id, c.id as current_id, c.sequence as current_sequence, c.state as current_state
      from scope s left join current_revision c on true
    )
    select m.project_id is not null as project_exists, m.claim_id is not null as claim_exists,
      (select anchor_valid from anchor_status) as anchor_valid,
      m.current_id, m.current_sequence, m.current_state, ps.has_more,
      r.id as revision_id, r.sequence, r.state, left(r.claim_text, 448) as claim_text_preview,
      (r.claim_text is not null and char_length(r.claim_text) > 448) as claim_text_truncated,
      left(r.researcher_note, 256) as researcher_note_preview,
      (r.researcher_note is not null and char_length(r.researcher_note) > 256) as researcher_note_truncated,
      r.created_at, r.finalized_at, r.support_status, r.direct_evidence_count,
      r.extraction_revision_count, r.synthesis_revision_count, r.total_support_count,
      r.citation_candidate_count, r.distinct_paper_count
    from meta m
    cross join page_state ps
    left join metrics r on true
    order by r.sequence::bigint desc nulls last, r.id desc nulls last

with scope as materialized (
      select p.id as project_id, s.id as statement_id
      from projects p
      left join synthesis_statements s on s.project_id=p.id and s.id=$1::uuid
      where p.id=$2::uuid
    ),
    current_revision as (
      select r.id, r.sequence::text as sequence, r.state
      from scope s
      join lateral (
        select current_r.id, current_r.sequence, current_r.state
        from synthesis_revisions current_r
        where current_r.project_id=s.project_id and current_r.synthesis_statement_id=s.statement_id
          and current_r.finalized_at is not null
        order by current_r.sequence desc
        limit 1
      ) r on true
    ),
    anchor_status as (select exists (
        select 1 from synthesis_revisions anchor
        join scope s on s.project_id=anchor.project_id and s.statement_id=anchor.synthesis_statement_id
        where anchor.id=$3::uuid
          and anchor.sequence=$4::bigint
          and anchor.finalized_at is not null
      ) as anchor_valid),
    page_candidates as materialized (
      select r.id, r.sequence::text as sequence, r.state, r.title, r.statement_text,
        r.researcher_note, r.created_at, r.finalized_at
      from scope s
      join synthesis_revisions r on r.project_id=s.project_id and r.synthesis_statement_id=s.statement_id
      where r.finalized_at is not null and (r.sequence, r.id) > ($5::bigint, $6::uuid) and (select anchor_valid from anchor_status)
      order by r.sequence asc, r.id asc
      limit $7
    ),
    visible_page as materialized (
      select * from page_candidates order by sequence::bigint asc, id asc limit $8
    ),
    page_state as (select count(*) > $9 as has_more from page_candidates),
    support_counts as (
      select s.synthesis_revision_id,
        count(distinct s.extraction_revision_id)::text as supporting_revision_count,
        count(distinct x.paper_id)::text as supporting_paper_count,
        count(distinct x.field_id)::text as supporting_field_count
      from visible_page v
      join synthesis_revision_supports s on s.project_id=$10::uuid and s.synthesis_revision_id=v.id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=s.project_id and x.id=s.extraction_revision_id
      group by s.synthesis_revision_id
    ),
    metrics as (
      select v.*, coalesce(c.supporting_revision_count, '0') as supporting_revision_count,
        coalesce(c.supporting_paper_count, '0') as supporting_paper_count,
        coalesce(c.supporting_field_count, '0') as supporting_field_count,
        (coalesce(c.supporting_revision_count::bigint, 0) > 0) as is_supported
      from visible_page v left join support_counts c on c.synthesis_revision_id=v.id
    ),
    meta as (
      select s.project_id, s.statement_id, c.id as current_id, c.sequence as current_sequence, c.state as current_state
      from scope s left join current_revision c on true
    )
    select m.project_id is not null as project_exists, m.statement_id is not null as statement_exists,
      (select anchor_valid from anchor_status) as anchor_valid,
      m.current_id, m.current_sequence, m.current_state, ps.has_more,
      r.id as revision_id, r.sequence, r.state, left(r.title, 96) as title_preview,
      (r.title is not null and char_length(r.title) > 96) as title_truncated,
      left(r.statement_text, 320) as statement_preview,
      (r.statement_text is not null and char_length(r.statement_text) > 320) as statement_truncated,
      left(r.researcher_note, 160) as researcher_note_preview,
      (r.researcher_note is not null and char_length(r.researcher_note) > 160) as researcher_note_truncated,
      r.created_at, r.finalized_at, r.is_supported,
      r.supporting_revision_count, r.supporting_paper_count, r.supporting_field_count
    from meta m

      union
      select s.claim_revision_id, x.paper_id
      from claim_revision_synthesis_supports s

      join synthesis_revision_supports ss on ss.project_id=s.project_id and ss.synthesis_revision_id=s.synthesis_revision_id
      join extraction_value_revisions x on x.project_id=ss.project_id and x.id=ss.extraction_revision_id

      union

      join visible_page v on v.id=s.claim_revision_id

      union

      from claim_revision_synthesis_supports s

      join synthesis_revision_supports ss on ss.project_id=s.project_id and ss.synthesis_revision_id=s.synthesis_revision_id

      r.citation_candidate_count, r.distinct_paper_count
    from meta m

    order by r.sequence::bigint desc nulls last, r.id desc nulls last

      select v.*, coalesce(l.child_count, '0') as limitation_count,
        coalesce(q.child_count, '0') as question_count,
        coalesce(c.child_count, '0') as contradiction_count
      from visible_page v
      left join limitation_counts l on l.interpretation_id=v.id
      left join question_counts q on q.interpretation_id=v.id
      left join contradiction_counts c on c.interpretation_id=v.id
    ),
    meta as (
      select s.project_id, s.statement_id, s.revision_id,
        c.id as current_id, c.sequence as current_sequence,
        c.convergence_state as current_convergence_state, c.finalized_at as current_finalized_at
      from scope s left join current_interpretation c on true
    )
    select m.project_id is not null as project_exists, m.statement_id is not null as statement_exists,
      m.revision_id is not null as revision_exists,
      (select anchor_valid from anchor_status) as anchor_valid,
      m.current_id, m.current_sequence, m.current_convergence_state,
      m.current_finalized_at,
      ps.has_more, r.id as interpretation_id, r.sequence, r.convergence_state,
      left(r.summary, 448) as summary_preview, (char_length(r.summary) > 448) as summary_truncated,
      left(r.researcher_note, 256) as researcher_note_preview,
      (r.researcher_note is not null and char_length(r.researcher_note) > 256) as researcher_note_truncated,
      r.created_at, r.finalized_at, r.limitation_count, r.question_count, r.contradiction_count
    from meta m
    cross join page_state ps
    left join metrics r on true
    order by r.sequence::bigint desc nulls last, r.id desc nulls last

plans.label: claim-current-sequence-map-50000
plans.sql:
with scope as materialized (
          select p.id as project_id, c.id as claim_id, c.created_at as claim_created_at,
            r.id as revision_id, r.sequence::text as revision_sequence
          from projects p
          join claims c on c.project_id=p.id and c.id=$1::uuid
          join claim_revisions r on r.project_id=c.project_id and r.claim_id=c.id
            and r.id=$2::uuid and r.finalized_at is not null
          where p.id=$3::uuid
        ),
        sequence_values as (
          select 'extraction_revision'::text as kind, x.id, x.sequence::text as sequence
          from scope s
          join claim_revision_extraction_supports support
            on support.project_id=s.project_id and support.claim_revision_id=s.revision_id
          join extraction_value_revisions x
            on x.project_id=s.project_id and x.id=support.extraction_revision_id
          union all
          select 'synthesis_revision'::text as kind, sr.id, sr.sequence::text as sequence
          from scope s
          join claim_revision_synthesis_supports support
            on support.project_id=s.project_id and support.claim_revision_id=s.revision_id
          join synthesis_revisions sr
            on sr.project_id=s.project_id and sr.id=support.synthesis_revision_id
          union all
          select 'extraction_revision'::text as kind, x.id, x.sequence::text as sequence
          from scope s
          join claim_revision_synthesis_supports claim_support
            on claim_support.project_id=s.project_id and claim_support.claim_revision_id=s.revision_id
          join synthesis_revision_supports support
            on support.project_id=s.project_id and support.synthesis_revision_id=claim_support.synthesis_revision_id
          join extraction_value_revisions x
            on x.project_id=s.project_id and x.id=support.extraction_revision_id
        )
        select s.project_id, s.claim_id, s.claim_created_at, s.revision_id,
          s.revision_sequence,
          $4::uuid as current_revision_id,
          coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(kind || ':' || id::text, sequence) from sequence_values), '{}'::jsonb) as sequence_map
        from scope s
        limit 1

plans.label: claim-exact-artifact-sequence-map-50000
plans.sql:
with scope as materialized (
          select p.id as project_id, c.id as claim_id, c.created_at as claim_created_at,
            r.id as revision_id, r.sequence::text as revision_sequence
          from projects p
          join claims c on c.project_id=p.id and c.id=$1::uuid
          join claim_revisions r on r.project_id=c.project_id and r.claim_id=c.id
            and r.id=$2::uuid and r.finalized_at is not null
          where p.id=$3::uuid
        ), current_revision as (
          select current_r.id
          from scope s
          join lateral (
            select latest.id
            from claim_revisions latest
            where latest.project_id=s.project_id and latest.claim_id=s.claim_id
              and latest.finalized_at is not null
            order by latest.sequence desc
            limit 1
          ) current_r on true
        ),
        sequence_values as (
          select 'extraction_revision'::text as kind, x.id, x.sequence::text as sequence
          from scope s
          join claim_revision_extraction_supports support
            on support.project_id=s.project_id and support.claim_revision_id=s.revision_id
          join extraction_value_revisions x
            on x.project_id=s.project_id and x.id=support.extraction_revision_id
          union all
          select 'synthesis_revision'::text as kind, sr.id, sr.sequence::text as sequence
          from scope s
          join claim_revision_synthesis_supports support
            on support.project_id=s.project_id and support.claim_revision_id=s.revision_id
          join synthesis_revisions sr
            on sr.project_id=s.project_id and sr.id=support.synthesis_revision_id
          union all
          select 'extraction_revision'::text as kind, x.id, x.sequence::text as sequence
          from scope s
          join claim_revision_synthesis_supports claim_support
            on claim_support.project_id=s.project_id and claim_support.claim_revision_id=s.revision_id
          join synthesis_revision_supports support
            on support.project_id=s.project_id and support.synthesis_revision_id=claim_support.synthesis_revision_id
          join extraction_value_revisions x
            on x.project_id=s.project_id and x.id=support.extraction_revision_id
        )
        select s.project_id, s.claim_id, s.claim_created_at, s.revision_id,
          s.revision_sequence,
          (select id from current_revision) as current_revision_id,
          coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(kind || ':' || id::text, sequence) from sequence_values), '{}'::jsonb) as sequence_map
        from scope s
        limit 1

plans.label: claim-withdrawn-latest-active-selector-50000
plans.sql:
select c.id as claim_id,
          (select active_revision.id
           from claim_revisions active_revision
           where active_revision.project_id=p.id and active_revision.claim_id=c.id
             and active_revision.state='active' and active_revision.finalized_at is not null
           order by active_revision.sequence desc
           limit 1) as revision_id
        from projects p
        left join claims c on c.project_id=p.id and c.id=$1
        where p.id=$2
        limit 1

          select p.id as project_id, s.id as statement_id, r.id as revision_id,
            r.sequence::text as sequence
          from projects p
          join synthesis_statements s on s.project_id=p.id and s.id=$1::uuid
          join synthesis_revisions r on r.project_id=s.project_id and r.synthesis_statement_id=s.id
            and r.id=$2::uuid and r.finalized_at is not null
          where p.id=$3::uuid
        )
        select scope.sequence,
          coalesce((
            select jsonb_object_agg(x.id::text, x.sequence::text)
            from synthesis_revision_supports support
            join extraction_value_revisions x
              on x.project_id=support.project_id and x.id=support.extraction_revision_id
            where support.project_id=scope.project_id and support.synthesis_revision_id=scope.revision_id
          ), '{}'::jsonb) as extraction_revision_sequences
        from scope
        limit 1

plans.label: synthesis-page-preparation-join-50000
plans.sql:
select
          p.id as preparation_id,
          p.evidence_set_id,
          es.name as evidence_set_name,
          es.archived_at as evidence_set_archived_at,
          p.evidence_set_composition_revision_id,
          cr.sequence as pinned_composition_sequence,
          p.finalized_at
        from synthesis_preparations p
        join evidence_sets es on es.project_id = p.project_id and es.id = p.evidence_set_id
        join evidence_set_composition_revisions cr on cr.project_id = p.project_id and cr.evidence_set_id = p.evidence_set_id and cr.id = p.evidence_set_composition_revision_id
        where p.project_id = $1 and p.finalized_synthesis_revision_id = $2
        limit 1

plans.sql:

          i.synthesis_revision_id, i.convergence_state, i.summary, i.researcher_note,
          i.created_at, i.finalized_at
        from synthesis_interpretations i
        join synthesis_revisions r on r.project_id=i.project_id
          and r.synthesis_statement_id=i.synthesis_statement_id and r.id=i.synthesis_revision_id
          and r.finalized_at is not null
        where i.project_id=$1::uuid and i.synthesis_statement_id=$2::uuid
          and i.synthesis_revision_id=$3::uuid and i.finalized_at is not null
          and i.id=$4::uuid
        order by i.sequence desc
        limit 1
